text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Good grief, to think it would end like this.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, oh well.
After all, we've only just gotten started, right?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
That makes one win for you.
Next, I'll make sure to add a defeat to your record.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hmph, I'll turn this into my second win just like that!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Dear me, what a predicament.
To think you'll be running in the Japan Cup,
and even CB is entering the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To ignore the proposal I agonized over formulating
and simply charge into a match following one's own whims…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Still, as long as it's fun, what's the harm!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, no stiff faces for you either, Rudolf.
Just get swept up in the excitement of this match like everyone around us.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: To be honest... you got excited, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O,
you are truly an astounding Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "...So astound us even more. With those legs of yours. Astound all of us."
